tape_read.note: Robust reference 21.13 (-0.85% vs 21.31 prev close), 124 prints, 16 in the last 30 min, last 09:11, not stale. Range 20.05-22.71 (-5.9% to +6.6%): two-sided and choppy through the 08:00 call. Against a frozen read of -16% and a 12.6% implied move, the pre-market holds almost none of the guide cut; either the market had the cut priced (stock near 52-week low, 26% short, +16.8 put skew) or the session has yet to reprice it. Short position is up about 1.4% from the 21.42 entry at the reference.

thesis_check.note: The take-rate leg (i0) failed: Q3 revenue $371m beat. The guide leg (i1) confirmed and more: the FY guide was cut, not merely reaffirmed, implying a Q4 well below the street.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market gap is under 1%, so 'less than half' is a coin toss on noise; the pre-market is active (not stale) but swung 12 points high to low, so the open could land anywhere in that band. Bmo with a guide cut that the tape has not priced leans toward further repricing down, not a fade.

recommendation.reason: Upstart verlaagde de jaarverwachting (omzet ~1,35 mld, EBITDA ~260 mln, lager dan eerder), wat het kernpunt van de short bevestigt, terwijl de koers voorbeurs bijna vlak staat. Een bmo-uitslag die nog niet in de koers zit wordt vaak in de loop van de dag verder verwerkt, dus de short aanhouden tot het slot; het vertrouwen is laag omdat het derde kwartaal zelf beter was dan verwacht.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Staat de koers voor 09:30 duidelijk boven 22 dollar (boven het vorige slot met ruim 3%), dan heeft de markt de verlaging kennelijk geslikt en is dekken bij de opening beter.
